items.title: Re-vendor LibKa0s v1.71.0 from the local tag; record the unrecorded v1.69.0/v1.70.0 span
items.spec: Mechanical re-vendor per dev-copilot commands/wow-revendor-libka0s.md, delta base read from AuraMaster's CLAUDE.md provenance line (v1.70.0), source = the LOCAL tag v1.71.0 in ../LibKa0s (never the feature-branch tip; the tag is not on origin). (1) Copy both payloads whole: `git -C ../LibKa0s archive v1.71.0 LibKa0s testkit` extracted into the scratchpad, then libs/LibKa0s/ replaced by LibKa0s/ and tests/_kit/ replaced by testkit/ (delete-then-copy so removed files go). No other edit under libs/ or tests/_kit/. (2) CLAUDE.md provenance line becomes `Bundles [LibKa0s](https://github.com/tusharsaxena/LibKa0s) v1.71.0 (MIT).`; live tag stamps that name the previous tag roll or, better, de-tag in favour of the provenance line: docs/module-map.md:293 (`LibKa0s v1.70.0` row), DEPENDENCIES.md:85 and :92 (`v1.70.0`), plus any `kit 37`/`revision 37` or `v1.68.1` stamp `grep -rn` finds in live docs (frozen docs/audits, docs/reviews, docs/automated-tests, docs/revendor, docs/perf-analysis bundles untouched). (3) Kit revision 38 changes the --list Totals semantics (LK-01: declared skips counted on their own Skipped row, Total = cases that run): regenerate docs/test-cases.md with `lua tests/run.lua --list > docs/test-cases.md` and roll the README Tests badge to the new Total in the same commit (badge equals Total, testing-§5). (4) Span bundle docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.69.0-v1.70.0/ holding ONLY 01_DELTA.md and 05_SUMMARY.md (shape of docs/revendor/2026-10-01-v1.64.0-v1.65.0/): 01_DELTA.md line 1 exactly `Delta: LibKa0s v1.69.0 -> v1.70.0 (span: v1.69.0 v1.70.0)`, the body states base v1.68.1 and lists per-file minor moves for each tag (read from ../LibKa0s CHANGELOG.md v1.69.0 and v1.70.0 blocks) with the vendoring commits 3656914 (v1.69.0) and c070393 (v1.70.0); 05_SUMMARY.md one line per tag: `carried by sweep, nothing adopted` (verify with `git log --oneline 3656914^..c070393` that no adoption commit exists; if one does, cite its sha instead). No back-filled per-tag bundles. (5) docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.71.0/ per the command: 01_DELTA.md (line 1 `Delta: LibKa0s v1.70.0 -> v1.71.0`; per-file LibStub minors: Env 2, Slash key 20.2, Widgets key 12.1.4.3.2 (LineChart 3, Autocomplete 2), Options key with OptionsIdList 4; kit 37 -> 38 with the pairing rule; which majors AuraMaster consumes; contract changes under unchanged signatures, e.g. ParseValue refusing nan/inf, flagged as blockers if any AuraMaster CLI path relies on them), 02_CANDIDATES.md (each new surface: Kit.secret, ChartMath.ClipSegment, etc., with file:line evidence from ../LibKa0s/docs/api/), 03_DECISIONS.md recording every candidate as `not adopted in this run` (OWNER_SCOPE 5: no interview, no GitHub issue), 05_SUMMARY.md. Register/index row wherever the prior bundles are registered (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:373 documentation map names the store; add a row only if a register lists bundles).
items.steps:
1. `git -C ../LibKa0s tag -l v1.71.0` prints the tag; read its CHANGELOG v1.69.0..v1.71.0 blocks.
2. Archive-extract to the scratchpad; replace libs/LibKa0s and tests/_kit whole; `diff -r` both against the extract.
3. Roll the CLAUDE.md provenance line and de-tag/roll the live stamps.
4. `lua tests/run.lua`; if a suite fails because a library contract moved, stop and record it as a blocker in 01_DELTA.md (do not edit payload).
5. Regenerate docs/test-cases.md; roll the README badge.
6. Write the span bundle, then the v1.71.0 bundle.
7. Green gate; commit `RV-AM: re-vendor LibKa0s v1.71.0; record v1.69.0-v1.70.0 span (AM-A-01)`.

items.title: /am select and /am delete resolve a bare number by exact name before id, refuse a cross-match, '#N' always means id
items.spec: settings/Slash.lua findContainer (about :166-:184), used by `select` and `delete`. New precedence: (a) arg trimmed; empty -> nil. (b) `#N` (N digits) always resolves as id N via NS.Database.FindContainer(N), never as a name. (c) Otherwise collect the exact case-insensitive name matches (as today; two or more -> the existing 'More than one container is called' refusal). (d) If arg is numeric (tonumber) AND a container named arg exists AND FindContainer(tonumber(arg)) is a DIFFERENT container, return nil plus a new enUS ambiguity sentence naming both, e.g. L["'%s' is both container #%s's name and container #%s's number — use #%s for the number"] (exact wording the implementer's, one locale key, enUS.lua only, formatted by the caller like the existing refusal). (e) Name match found -> it. (f) Numeric with no name match -> FindContainer(id) as today. Same container answering both name and id -> that container. The validator keeps accepting numeric names (forbidding them was rejected). The destructive delete path therefore never removes a container other than the one the player named. docs/slash-dispatch.md rows 12 (`select`) and 14 (`delete`) document the precedence; the `/am delete` help row (Slash.lua:70) and 'No such container' text stay unless the new `#N` form needs mentioning (add '#id' to the delete/select help text only if it fits the row shape).
items.steps:
1. Red first in tests/test_slash_verbs.lua: four cases — container named '3' plus a different container with id 3: `/am delete 3` refuses with the ambiguity line and deletes nothing; `/am delete #3` deletes id 3; a container named '7' with no id 7: `/am select 7` selects it by name; a numeric arg matching only an id still resolves by id. Add `-- red under:` notes; run and see them fail.
2. Implement the precedence in findContainer; add the enUS key.
3. Update docs/slash-dispatch.md rows 12 and 14.
4. regenerate docs/test-cases.md with `lua tests/run.lua --list > docs/test-cases.md` and roll the README Tests badge to the new Total in the same commit.
5. Green gate; commit `AM-01: ...`.

items.title: Schema-migration summary lines reach the log through DebugAtEnable
items.spec: core/Database.lua NS.RunMigrations ladder (about :1240-:1406): every ladder-level gated NS.Debug('Migrate', ...) call — each step's per-profile summary (:1252, :1260, :1274, :1290, :1298, :1306, :1314, :1322, :1330, :1338, :1346), the '[Migrate] v%s -> v%s' stamp line (:1377) and the starter-seed line (:1405) — goes through NS.DebugLog.DebugAtEnable('Migrate', fmt, ...) instead (same format strings and args, so the text is byte-identical once flushed). debug-logging-§8 Lifecycle coverage: schema migration when one runs is a MUST line, and the runner only runs from NS:InitDB at OnInitialize (:292) while State.debug is false. The library-absent stub at core/DebugLogSetup.lua:60 already supplies DebugAtEnable (returns false), so no new stub member. Per-container lines inside the MigrateVn step bodies (e.g. :153, :198, :688, :786, :792) stay gated NS.Debug: they are reached through the step test seams with logging on, and routing them would flood the 32-entry DebugAtEnable buffer on a large profile; the per-step summary already counts them. Failed steps keep printing to chat (:1373-1374).
items.steps:
1. Red first (tests/test_database.lua or the suite that already drives NS.RunMigrations with a pre-v12 profile): logging off, run migrations, then NS.DebugLog.SetEnabled(true) (via the harness's DebugLog) and assert the log holds the '[Migrate] vX -> vY' line after the [Init] lines; assert nothing was logged while off. `-- red under:` note.
2. Swap the ladder-level calls to DebugAtEnable.
3. regenerate docs/test-cases.md with `lua tests/run.lua --list > docs/test-cases.md` and roll the README Tests badge to the new Total in the same commit.
4. Green gate; commit `AM-02: ...`.

items.title: Peel the frozen schema migrations out of core/Database.lua into core/Database_Migrations.lua
items.spec: core/Database.lua is 1406 lines (layout-§1 band; its own RESULTS.md trigger 'the migrations are the seam to peel' has fired). Move verbatim into new core/Database_Migrations.lua: Database.MigrateV2..MigrateV12 (about :463-:1209), their private helpers and frozen id tables (normalize/lift helpers, KNOWN_AURA_TYPES, etc.). Keep in core/Database.lua: SCHEMA_STEPS, climbLadder, NS.RunMigrations (with AM-02's DebugAtEnable lines), EachProfile, AceDB init, defaults, registry read helpers (savedvariables-§1 home). Helpers both files need: publish normalizeKeys as Database.NormalizeKeys (and any other shared private, e.g. DeepCopy, rebound as a local from NS in the new file) rather than duplicating. The new file binds `local Database = NS.Database` and only adds members; it loads right after core\Database.lua in AuraMaster.toc with a `# Conventional:` note if the TOC carries per-line notes; tests/run.lua or the harness loader loads it in TOC order (test_loadorder enforces TOC paths). SCHEMA_STEPS must reference the step functions late (by Database.MigrateVn lookup at run time) or the ladder must be built after both files load — confirm which today and keep runtime order valid (RunMigrations runs at OnInitialize, after every file loads). Update docs/module-map.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and every `core/Database.lua:<line>` citation in live docs and comments that pointed at moved code (grep). Result ~480 / ~920 lines.

1. Snapshot: `lua tests/run.lua` Total and all migration-suite results.
